newsitem.title: CYPRUS: CYPRUS BOURSE RETREATS BY MARGIN IN MID-WEEK.
newsitem.headline: CYPRUS BOURSE RETREATS BY MARGIN IN MID-WEEK.

text.p: The Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) showed a marginal retreat of 0.50 points in mid-week trading on Wednesday in a bearish market where most major stocks eased.
The 41-share CSE index, set at 100 points, closed at 83.35 on Wednesday after gradually slipping 0.50 points from the 83.85 it closed at on Friday.

The market has been losing ground for the past six trading days with the exception of Thursday. Last Monday the market opened on a bull run with gains of 1.01 percent, the highest mark seen on the market this month.
Banking stocks closed at 91.06 from 91.12 on Friday.

Fully-paid shares of the Bank of Cyprus closed at 342.5, losing 3.5 cents from 346 it closed at on Friday. Fully-paid shares in the Cyprus Popular Bank went up two cents, closing at 325.5 from 323.5. on Friday. Fully paid shares of Hellenic Bank went up six cents, closing at 264.5.
Fully paid shares in the Universal Savings Bank went down 3.5 cents to close at 135.5.

The sub index for tourism enterprises lost the gains it made last week and closed at 73.24 from 74.79 on Friday. The largest company in the sector, the Cyprus Tourism Development Company, owners of the Cyprus Hilton, shares closed at 885, down 25 cents from Friday's closing figure of 910.
The index of the insurance sector closed barely unchanged at 61.64.

Universal Life Insurance closed at 377, down 6.5 cents from Friday. Paneuropean Insurance fully paid closed at 142 from 137 on Friday and fully paid shares in subsidiary Interamerican Insurance closed at 104.5 from 106 last week.
In the manufacturing sector, Vassiliko Cement dropped 2.5 cents to close at 147.5. National carrier Cyprus Airways closed at 46.5 cents, unchanged from Friday.
